intro: Clarity Group deploys operational talent at scale across five subsidiaries. Every role below sits inside a live operating business.

jobs.title: Resident Engineer (RE)
scope: Supervise day-to-day construction activities on site to confirm works follow the approved drawings, specifications and the appointed Professional Engineer's instructions.
Inspect and record structural and civil works at key stages, including formwork, reinforcement, steel erection and concreting.
Review contractor submissions, method statements and material approvals before the related works proceed.
Monitor workmanship, materials and testing against applicable codes and standards, and raise non-conformances.
Keep site diaries, inspection records and progress reports up to date and submit them on time.
Coordinate with the main contractor, subcontractors, consultants and authorities on technical and site-supervision matters.
Enforce workplace safety and health requirements on site and report unsafe conditions immediately.
Support inspections, handover and close-out documentation.
requirements: Degree or diploma in Civil or Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
Relevant site supervision experience on building or civil projects in Singapore is preferred.
Familiarity with Singapore building control and workplace safety requirements.
Able to read and interpret structural drawings and specifications.
Safety certifications required for site entry, as specified by the project.

jobs.title: Structural Steel Foreman
scope: Lead and supervise a structural steel erection and fabrication crew on site, assigning daily tasks and confirming they are completed to plan.
Read and interpret structural steel drawings, and set out, lift and position members to specification.
Coordinate crane, lifting and rigging activities with the lifting supervisor and appointed persons.
Check bolting, welding and alignment, and verify completed work before inspection.
Keep materials, tools and lifting gear in good order and properly stored.
Enforce work-at-height, hot-work and lifting safety procedures, and conduct toolbox briefings.
Report progress, shortages and issues to the site engineer or supervisor.
Guide workers on correct methods and the proper use of PPE.
requirements: Proven experience in structural steel erection on site, including leading a crew.
Able to read structural and fabrication drawings.
Relevant certifications such as work-at-height, rigging or signalman are preferred.
Strong safety awareness and familiarity with lifting and hot-work permit requirements.
Able to communicate clearly with workers, engineers and supervisors.

jobs.title: General Manpower — Construction
scope: Carry out general site works as directed by supervisors, including material handling, loading, unloading and housekeeping.
Assist skilled trades such as scaffolding, formwork, steel and civil crews under supervision.
Move, stack and store materials safely, keeping work areas clean and clear.
Use hand tools and equipment correctly after proper instruction.
Wear the required PPE and follow site safety rules, signage and permit-to-work conditions.
Attend toolbox meetings and safety briefings.
Report hazards, injuries and near misses immediately.
requirements: Physically fit and able to work outdoors for extended hours.
Prior construction experience is an advantage but not required.
Valid construction safety orientation (for example CSOC), or willing to obtain it before starting.
Able to follow instructions and work as part of a team.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer, BuiltSync
scope: Design, build and maintain web features and back-end services for BuiltSync, which synchronizes live site data across projects.
Develop APIs and data pipelines that move field data between mobile apps, the platform and dashboards in near real time.
Build clear, responsive interfaces for site teams, project managers and management users.
Model and maintain databases, keeping data accurate, secure and auditable.
Write tested, maintainable code and take part in code review.
Monitor performance and reliability in production, and resolve issues promptly.
Work with operations and product stakeholders to turn field requirements into working features.
requirements: Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on experience with both front-end and back-end development, including REST APIs and relational databases.
Familiarity with cloud deployment and version-control workflows.
Interest in construction, facilities or industrial operations is a plus.

jobs.title: Mobile App Developer (iOS/Android)
scope: Build and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android used to capture and view field data on site.
Implement offline-tolerant data capture and reliable synchronization with the Lenix back end.
Integrate device features such as camera, location and notifications where required.
Turn designs and field workflows into fast, intuitive screens for on-site users.
Prepare and maintain app releases for distribution through the App Store and Google Play.
Test, debug and optimize performance across devices and OS versions.
Collaborate with back-end and design colleagues on APIs and release planning.
requirements: Experience developing native or cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and/or Android.
Familiarity with REST APIs, local data storage and the app-store release process.
Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Published apps or a portfolio of mobile work is preferred.

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant
scope: Receive, sort, transfer and arrange import/export air cargo.
Load and unload cargo from pallets, containers, trolleys and designated storage areas.
Perform cargo build-up and breakdown activities according to operational requirements.
Check cargo markings, labels, quantities and physical condition.
Move cargo using pallet jacks, trolleys and other approved material-handling equipment.
Segregate cargo according to flight, destination, shipment type or operational instruction.
Maintain proper housekeeping and safe working conditions within the warehouse.
Comply with airport security, safety and cargo-handling procedures.
Perform other warehouse and cargo-handling duties assigned by supervisors.

jobs.title: Manifesting Staff
scope: Prepare, verify and process air cargo manifests and related shipment documents.
Check shipment details such as airway bill numbers, destination, weight, quantity and flight information.
Perform system data entry and update cargo movement records accurately.
Coordinate with warehouse operations regarding cargo readiness and shipment status.
Ensure documents are completed and submitted within required flight cut-off times.
Identify discrepancies and escalate documentation or shipment issues to supervisors.
Maintain proper filing and document-control records.
Liaise with airline, cargo and operational personnel when required.

SATS Airfreight Terminal 6 — 20 Airline Road, Singapore 819833

jobs.title: Forklift Operator cum Warehouse Assistant
scope: Operate forklift safely for loading, unloading, stacking and movement of air cargo.
Transport pallets, containers and cargo between designated warehouse locations.
Conduct basic pre-use inspection of forklift equipment before operation.
Ensure cargo is properly positioned and secured before movement.
Support warehouse build-up, breakdown, sorting and cargo-transfer activities.
Observe designated travel routes, speed limits and warehouse safety rules.
Report damaged cargo, unsafe conditions or equipment defects immediately.
Assist with general warehouse duties when forklift operation is not required.
requirements: Valid/relevant forklift competency or certification is preferred/required according to site requirements.
workLocations: SATS Airfreight Terminal 5 — 30 Airline Road, Singapore 819830
SATS Airfreight Terminal 6 — 20 Airline Road, Singapore 819833

jobs.title: ADV Driver
scope: Operate assigned Airport Driving Vehicle/airside vehicle for transportation of cargo, equipment or operational materials.
Conduct vehicle pre-use checks before commencing work.
Transport items safely between designated airport/cargo operational areas.
Follow airport traffic rules, designated routes and operational instructions.
Ensure loads are properly positioned and secured prior to movement.
Maintain communication with operations/controllers regarding assigned movements.
Report vehicle defects, incidents or abnormal conditions immediately.
Maintain cleanliness and basic condition of assigned vehicle.
Perform other operational duties when required.

jobs.title: Food Packer
scope: Prepare and pack food items according to airline catering requirements.
Arrange meal components, utensils, beverages and related catering items.
Check product quantity, presentation and packaging before dispatch.
Follow food hygiene, sanitation and contamination-control requirements.
Maintain cleanliness of workstations, trays, equipment and production areas.
Follow FIFO, temperature-control and food-handling procedures where applicable.
Report damaged, contaminated or incorrect products immediately.
Support tray-setting, food preparation and other production activities when required.
Perform repetitive standing and packing duties in a fast-paced operational environment.

jobs.title: Manifesting Staff
scope: Prepare and maintain operational manifests and documentation.
Perform accurate data entry and verification of required information.
Coordinate with operational teams regarding preparation and dispatch status.
Check documentation for completeness and discrepancies.
Maintain filing and records according to company procedures.
Escalate discrepancies promptly to the supervisor.
Perform administrative and operational support duties as assigned.

jobs.title: NTL Operator
jobs.note: Candidates are required to attend a second interview with the client.
scope: Meet and receive designated passengers requiring special handling.
Escort NTL (Not To Land) and other special-category passengers between immigration, holding areas and boarding gates.
Coordinate closely with airline representatives and airport/immigration personnel.
Verify passenger identity, flight information and handling instructions.
Ensure passengers are escorted to the correct designated location.
Assist with relevant documentation and administrative processes.
Monitor passenger movements and comply with airport security procedures.
Provide professional and courteous passenger assistance.
Support wheelchair or other passenger-handling activities when required.

jobs.title: Wheelchair cum Odd Size Baggage Assistant
jobs.note: Candidates are required to attend a second interview with the client.
scope: Assist passengers requiring wheelchair or mobility assistance throughout the airport.
Meet passengers at assigned arrival/departure points and escort them safely.
Assist passengers between check-in, immigration, boarding gates and arrival areas.
Handle and transport odd-size baggage according to operational procedures.
Assist with items such as strollers, wheelchairs, sports equipment and oversized luggage.
Provide courteous assistance to elderly passengers, families and passengers with special needs.
Coordinate with airline and airport personnel when required.
Follow airport security, baggage-handling and safety requirements.

jobs.title: Electrical Stacker Operator
scope: Operate electric stacker/powered material-handling equipment safely.
Load, unload, stack and retrieve palletized goods.
Transfer goods between receiving, storage, picking and dispatch areas.
Conduct equipment pre-use checks before operation.
Ensure pallets and loads are stable before lifting or movement.
Follow warehouse traffic routes and safe stacking limits.
Support general warehouse operations when required.
Report equipment defects, damaged goods and unsafe conditions immediately.
Maintain housekeeping within assigned warehouse areas.

jobs.title: Class 3 Delivery Driver
scope: Operate Class 3 delivery vehicle for transportation and delivery of goods.
Conduct pre-trip vehicle inspection and report defects.
Load and unload goods according to delivery schedules.
Verify delivery orders, quantities and receiving documentation.
Ensure goods are properly secured during transportation.
Complete delivery documentation and obtain acknowledgement where required.
Follow assigned delivery routes and schedules.
Comply with Singapore road traffic and company safety requirements.
Maintain cleanliness and basic condition of assigned vehicle.
Assist with warehouse/loading activities when required.
requirements: Valid Singapore Class 3 driving licence.

jobs.title: Warehouse Assistant
scope: Perform receiving, sorting, storage and movement of air cargo.
Load and unload cargo from pallets, containers and vehicles.
Perform cargo build-up and breakdown activities.
Check cargo labels, quantity and physical condition.
Segregate and arrange shipments according to operational instructions.
Operate approved manual material-handling equipment where required.
Maintain accurate cargo movement and handling records.
Maintain good housekeeping within warehouse areas.
Follow aviation security, workplace safety and cargo-handling procedures.
Perform other operational duties assigned by supervisors.

jobs.title: NTL cum Wheelchair Operator
scope: Meet and greet passengers in a warm, professional and courteous manner.

Assist designated airlines in transporting and escorting special-category passengers including NTL (Not To Land), UM (Unaccompanied Minor), deportees, offloaded passengers and other special-handling passengers.
Escort passengers between aircraft gates, immigration offices, designated holding areas and other airport locations.
Assist airlines with preparation, completion and submission of relevant flight or passenger-handling documents.
Provide wheelchair assistance and transport passengers requiring mobility support.
Assist hearing-impaired, visually impaired, elderly or other passengers requiring special assistance.
Verify passenger name, flight information and Special Service Request details before movement.
Ensure passengers are brought to the correct destination safely and punctually.
Communicate and coordinate with airline representatives, Immigration officers and other airport personnel.
Attend to passenger enquiries and provide excellent customer service.
Monitor assigned passengers during the handling process and comply with security requirements.
Assist with wheelchair pushing and other related passenger-service duties.
Perform any other operational or ad-hoc duties assigned by management.
profile: Service-oriented and comfortable interacting with passengers from different backgrounds.
Able to communicate clearly and professionally.
Able to work rotating shifts, weekends and public holidays.
Physically fit and able to push wheelchairs and walk for extended periods within the airport.
Able to remain calm when handling sensitive or challenging passenger situations.
Must comply with airport security and pass requirements.
Previous airport, airline, hospitality or customer-service experience is advantageous.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Operator
scope: Operate and monitor automated production equipment through the machine human-machine interface (HMI), following standard work instructions.
Load materials, start production runs and keep the line running to the production schedule.
Perform in-process checks on output and flag parts or settings that are out of tolerance.
Record production counts, data and downtime accurately.
Carry out routine cleaning, basic upkeep and changeovers as instructed.
Follow safety, quality and housekeeping procedures, including lockout/tagout and PPE requirements.
Report faults, abnormalities and near misses to the supervisor or technician promptly.
Work rotating shifts as scheduled.
requirements: Secondary education or higher; a technical certificate in mechanical, mechatronics or a similar field is an advantage.
Prior production or machine-operation experience is preferred.
Able to stand for long periods and follow work instructions precisely.
Willing to work shifts as scheduled.

jobs.title: Calibration Technician
scope: Calibrate, verify and adjust measuring and test instruments against reference standards on a defined schedule.
Use precision measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers and gauges accurately.
Maintain calibration records, certificates, labels and due-date tracking.
Identify out-of-tolerance equipment, quarantine it and report it to Quality for assessment.
Support inspection of fabricated parts against drawings and specified tolerances.
Care for reference standards and keep the calibration area clean and controlled.
Follow the quality management system and relevant ISO procedures, and support audits.
Recommend improvements to calibration methods and intervals.
requirements: Diploma or NITEC in Mechanical, Precision Engineering, Metrology or a related discipline.
Calibration or QC inspection experience in a manufacturing environment is preferred.
Able to read engineering drawings and interpret tolerances.
Careful, accurate record-keeping.

jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Specialist
scope: Deploy, configure and maintain servers, network equipment, end-user devices and related infrastructure across group sites.
Monitor systems and networks, respond to incidents and restore service within agreed targets.
Manage user accounts, access rights, backups and patching in line with security policies.
Administer cloud and on-premise services, wireless and site connectivity.
Maintain asset inventories, configuration records and documentation.
Provide second-line technical support to staff and escalate vendor issues.
Support rollouts and upgrades with minimal disruption to operations.
Contribute to security, disaster-recovery and business-continuity planning.
requirements: Diploma or degree in IT, Computer Engineering or a related field.
Hands-on experience with networking (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi), Windows or Linux server administration and endpoint management.
Working knowledge of cloud services and backup and recovery practices.
Relevant certifications (for example CCNA, Microsoft or CompTIA) are an advantage.
Able to travel between sites when required.
